info.title: bridge-watch API
info.description: On-chain risk intelligence API for AI agents on Base: address labels, transaction explain, sybil clustering, CCTP tracking, alerts. Pay per request with USDC via x402 (HTTP 402 auto-negotiated).
info.x-guidance: All /v1/* endpoints are paid via x402: call without auth, read the 402/401 response body for the PaymentRequired challenge, pay with USDC on Base (eip155:8453) to payTo 0x381cdbb664608bf7b1dd4f9403a572c1c57332c2, then retry with X-Payment header or Authorization: Bearer <payment-address>. /healthz and /statusz are free. See /.well-known/x402 for the full manifest.

x-version.note: restSpec is the version of this OpenAPI document; product/mcpServer are the live bridge-watch release, sourced from GET /mcp and MCP initialize at build time

tools.name: get_label
tools.description: Look up the identity label of an EVM address (Base, open eth-labels dataset; mostly category tags rather than named entities). Returns which entity the address belongs to; unlabelled addresses return null. Call with no arguments for a free demo result.

tools.name: explain_transaction
tools.description: Explain what a transaction did: status, sender/receiver (with identity labels), transfer details, and whether it looks like a cross-chain bridge operation.

tools.name: detect_cluster
tools.description: Detect the set of addresses funded by a single funder (shared funding-source cluster). Useful for sybil / entity detection.

tools.name: query_alerts
tools.description: Query historical alert records; filterable by address, rule kind, severity, and time range.

tools.name: alert_stats
tools.description: Alert statistics overview: totals, breakdown by kind / severity / address, and the latest alert time.

tools.name: track_cctp
tools.description: CCTP cross-chain transfer tracking: given a source-chain tx hash, find which transfer it belongs to, how much moved, the destination chain, and whether it arrived. Supports Base → Ethereum and other CCTP chains.

tools.name: list_paid_endpoints
tools.description: List every paid HTTP endpoint of this service with its live per-call price in USDC on Base. Takes no arguments. Call this first to discover what you can buy and what it costs.

howToCall: POST https://agentsapi.top/mcp with Content-Type: application/json and Accept: application/json, text/event-stream
Body is JSON-RPC 2.0: initialize (free) → tools/list (free) → tools/call (paid)
A paid tool/call returns a PaymentRequired object inside the JSON-RPC result; the /mcp protocol plane itself never returns HTTP 402
Pay USDC on Base to payTo, then retry tools/call with the payer address as Authorization: Bearer <address> (or x402 payment-signature header)

Anonymous free tier: 7 tool calls per IP per day, 1 per tool across all 7 tools (get_label, explain_transaction, detect_cluster, query_alerts, alert_stats, track_cctp, list_paid_endpoints; no wallet, no signup)

post.summary: MCP JSON-RPC 2.0 endpoint (7 tools, x402 metered)
post.description: Streamable-HTTP MCP endpoint. Protocol methods initialize / tools/list / ping are free; tools/call is metered in USDC on Base via x402. The protocol plane answers HTTP 200 — a payment requirement is delivered as a PaymentRequired object inside the JSON-RPC result, not as HTTP 402. Anonymous callers get 7 free tool calls per IP per day, 1 per tool, covering all 7 tools: get_label, explain_transaction, detect_cluster, query_alerts, alert_stats, track_cctp, list_paid_endpoints.
